# AI Engineering OS v0.1.2

## Highlights

- Defines the workflow compiler architecture for reusable engineering workflows.
- Adds the runtime parity contract for complete adapter-owned installations.
- Plans generation of root-level runtime files such as `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md`,
  hooks, metadata, and safe artifact ownership.
- Preserves schema 1 manifests and legacy adapter compatibility during the
  migration to workflow compilation.
